{{short description|Award of the Edinburgh Mathematical Society}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
The '''''Sir Edmund Whittaker Memorial Prize''''' is awarded every four years by the [[Edinburgh Mathematical Society]] to an outstanding young mathematician having a specified connection with [[Scotland]]. It is named after Sir [[Edmund Whittaker]].

==History==
After the death of Sir Edmund Whittaker in 1956, his son [[John Macnaghten Whittaker]] donated on behalf of the Whittaker Family the sum of £500 to the Edinburgh Mathematical Society to establish a prize for mathematical work in memory of his father. As of 2009, the award money remains £500.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Whittaker rules 2013|url=http://www.ems.ac.uk/wiki/tiki-download_wiki_attachment.php?attId=104&page=Whittaker%20Prize&download=y|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141205111037/http://www.ems.ac.uk/wiki/tiki-download_wiki_attachment.php?attId=104&page=Whittaker%20Prize&download=y|archive-date=5 December 2014|access-date=|website=[[Edinburgh Mathematical Society]]}}</ref>

==Winners==
*2023 Jonathan Fraser (University of St Andrews)
*2021 Ben Davison (University of Edinburgh)
*2019 Michela Ottobre (Heriot-Watt University)
*2016 [[Arend Bayer]] (University of Edinburgh)
*2013 Stuart White (University of Glasgow) 
*2009 [[Agata Smoktunowicz]] (University of Edinburgh)<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Whittaker Prize : EMS|url=http://www.ems.ac.uk/wiki/tiki-index.php?page=Whittaker%20Prize|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141205111037/http://www.ems.ac.uk/wiki/tiki-index.php?page=Whittaker%20Prize|archive-date=5 December 2014|access-date=30 November 2014|website=[[Edinburgh Mathematical Society]]}}</ref>
*2005 [[Tom Bridgeland]] (University of Sheffield)
*2001 [[Michael McQuillan (mathematician)|Michael McQuillan]] and J A Sherratt
*1997 Alan D Rendall (Max-Planck-Institut für Gravitationsphysik)
*1993 Mitchell A. Berger and [[Alan Reid (mathematician)|Alan W. Reid]]<ref>{{Cite journal|date=June 1994|title=Sir Edmund Whittaker Memorial Prize|journal=Proceedings of the Edinburgh Mathematical Society|language=en|volume=37|issue=2|pages=359–360|doi=10.1017/S0013091500006131|issn=1464-3839|doi-access=free}}</ref>
*1989 A A Lacey and [[Michael Röckner]]
*1985 [[John Mackintosh Howie]]
*1981 [[John M. Ball]] (University of Oxford)
*1977 [[Gavin Brown (academic)|Gavin Brown]] and C A Stuart
*1973 A M Davie (University of Edinburgh)
*1970 [[Derek J. S. Robinson|Derek J S Robinson]] (University of Illinois)
*1965 [[John Bryce McLeod]] (University of Oxford)
*1961 A G Mackie and [[Andrew H. Wallace]]
